profile_text: With 4,015 employees as of 2024, this professional services firm has experienced a remarkable 122.4% growth, driven by its expertise in management consulting and advisory services. As a leading provider of strategic guidance, it helps clients navigate complex business challenges, leveraging its team of 52 professionals and a strong capital base of €570,800. Its rapid expansion is a testament to the increasing demand for specialized consulting services in the professional, scientific, and technical activities sector.
